font_policy: font reconstruction never invents original font identity or embedding rights
object_stream_signature_policy: object-stream packing is a full rewrite; previous cryptographic signatures are invalidated or become modified-document evidence

persistent_corruption_denial.message: checkpoint restore verifies schema and sha256 before decoding bounded JSON nodes

raster_limits.memory_policy: bounded decoded pixels plus component/point caps
raster_limits.scheduler_admission: runs through existing image decode admission path

remaining_exact_limits: raster vectorization reconstructs bounded shape evidence, not original authoring paths
photographs, noisy scans beyond caps, and dense continuous-tone artwork are exact unsupported/report-only cases
font reconstruction repairs usable metadata/mapping posture from available evidence; original font identity and licensing rights are never inferred
external glyph generation is disabled by default and requires explicit backend provenance/license/privacy metadata
persistent store merge support reports conflicts; it does not silently auto-merge conflicting page-content edits
object-stream packing is deterministic full rewrite; it does not preserve existing cryptographic signatures
linearized inputs are not claimed to remain linearized after object-stream packing unless a linearizer is run separately
